title: Create a Responsible account using email
description: Validate successful account creation and entry into the Responsible onboarding flow.
preconditions: BA Protege+ is installed; user has a valid email address not previously registered; internet connection is available.
steps:
1. Open BA Protege+.
2. Select the Responsible mode.
3. Choose the create-account option.
4. Enter valid required registration details.
5. Submit the registration form.
expected_result: The account is created successfully and the user can continue into the Responsible setup flow without an unexpected error.

title: Sign in with an existing Google account
description: Validate the available Google sign-in option for a user with an eligible Google account.
preconditions: BA Protege+ is installed; a valid Google account is available; internet connection is available; account state is known (new or previously linked).
steps:
1. Open BA Protege+.
2. Select the Responsible mode.
3. Open the login screen.
4. Select Continue with Google.
5. Choose the intended Google account.
6. Complete any consent or authentication prompt.
expected_result: Google authentication completes and the app establishes the expected authenticated session. The resulting account state is consistent with the selected Google account.

title: Complete initial Responsible setup
description: Validate the main initial setup path for a newly authenticated Responsible user.
preconditions: User is authenticated as Responsible and has not completed initial setup.
steps:
1. Continue from successful registration or login.
2. Select the intended usage mode.
3. Complete the initial configuration screens using valid data.
4. Continue through the setup flow.
expected_result: The initial setup completes and the user reaches the appropriate next screen without being blocked by optional permissions.

title: Reach the daily-use Home after initial setup
description: Validate the transition from first-time setup to the normal Home experience.
preconditions: User has completed the initial Responsible setup.
steps:
1. From the setup completion screen, select the option to return to the beginning/Home.
2. Observe the Home screen.
expected_result: The daily-use Home screen is displayed rather than the first-time onboarding Home.

title: Activate and configure Self-Control
description: Validate the available independent Self-Control flow on the Responsible device.
preconditions: User is authenticated in Responsible mode; Self-Control feature is available in the current build; internet connection is available if required by the feature.
steps:
1. Open the Self-Control section.
2. Start or activate Self-Control.
3. Configure the available protection settings.
4. Save or confirm the configuration.
5. Verify the configured state and available blocking behavior using an approved test site.
expected_result: Self-Control can be activated and configured independently of linking another protected device. The saved configuration is reflected in the UI and the configured protection behavior is applied.

title: Display Responsible mode entry options
description: Verify that the user can identify and select Responsible mode during entry.
preconditions: App is installed and opened in a clean or logged-out state.
steps:
1. Launch the application.
2. Review the available modes.
3. Select Responsible mode.
expected_result: Responsible mode is available and the application navigates to the corresponding authentication or onboarding flow.

title: Register with valid email details
description: Verify validation and submission of a valid email-based registration form.
preconditions: User is on the account creation screen; email is not already registered.
steps:
1. Enter valid values in all required fields.
2. Submit the form.
expected_result: The form accepts valid data and proceeds with account creation. No validation error is displayed for valid fields.

title: Prevent registration with an invalid email
description: Verify client-side or server-side validation for malformed email input.
preconditions: User is on the account creation screen.
steps:
1. Enter an invalid email format.
2. Complete other required fields with valid values.
3. Submit the form.
expected_result: Registration is not completed. A clear validation message identifies the invalid email field.

title: Prevent registration with missing required fields
description: Verify required-field validation during account creation.
preconditions: User is on the account creation screen.
steps:
1. Leave one or more required fields empty.
2. Submit the form.
expected_result: Registration is not completed and the missing required fields are indicated. The exact required fields should match the current UI.

title: Sign in with valid email credentials
description: Verify standard email/password authentication.
preconditions: A registered Responsible account exists and the user is logged out.
steps:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Enter the registered email and correct password.
3. Submit the login form.
expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the user enters the authenticated Responsible experience.

title: Reject login with an incorrect password
description: Verify that invalid credentials do not establish a session.
preconditions: A registered Responsible account exists and the user is logged out.
steps:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Enter the registered email and an incorrect password.
3. Submit the login form.
expected_result: Authentication is rejected, the user remains logged out, and an appropriate error message is displayed.

title: Handle Google sign-in cancellation
description: Verify behavior when the user cancels the Google authentication flow.
preconditions: User is on the login screen; Google sign-in is available.
steps:
1. Select Continue with Google.
2. Cancel or close the Google account selection/authentication prompt.
expected_result: The app does not create an authenticated session and returns to a stable login state without crashing.

title: Handle Google sign-in with an existing linked account
description: Verify the expected account behavior when the selected Google identity is already associated with an account.
preconditions: A Google identity is already linked to an existing BA Protege+ account.
steps:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Select Continue with Google.
3. Choose the already-linked Google identity.
4. Complete authentication.
expected_result: The existing associated account is accessed; no unintended duplicate account is created.

title: Display optional permission requests during setup
description: Verify that the available permission options are presented to the user.
preconditions: User is progressing through Responsible initial setup on a compatible Android device.
steps:
1. Continue through setup until the permissions screen or prompts appear.
2. Review VPN, Accessibility, Notifications, Battery Optimization and Location options.
expected_result: The available permission options are displayed with understandable labels and actions. No permission is assumed mandatory based on the current product definition.

title: Continue setup without granting optional permissions
description: Verify that declining or skipping optional permissions does not block setup.
preconditions: User is at the permission stage; none of the listed permissions has been granted.
steps:
1. Decline or skip each optional permission when prompted.
2. Continue through the setup flow.
expected_result: The app allows the user to continue. Setup is not blocked solely because optional permissions were not granted.

title: Grant an optional permission and return to the app
description: Verify that granting an optional permission returns the user to a usable app state.
preconditions: User is at a permission prompt; the Android system permission/settings screen is available.
steps:
1. Select the action to configure one optional permission.
2. Grant or enable that permission in Android.
3. Return to BA Protege+.
expected_result: The app resumes without crashing and reflects the updated permission state where applicable.

title: Generate a six-digit device-linking PIN
description: Verify the Responsible-side availability of the PIN generation path.
preconditions: User is authenticated in Responsible mode; the linking feature is available; protected mode completion is not required for this test.
steps:
1. Open Devices.
2. Select the option to link a new device.
3. Choose the six-digit PIN method.
4. Observe the generated or displayed PIN flow.
expected_result: The PIN method opens and presents the expected six-digit code or the corresponding code-generation state on the Responsible side. Full end-to-end linking is out of scope until Protected mode is ready.

title: Display the QR linking alternative
description: Verify that the QR alternative can be selected independently from the PIN method.
preconditions: User is authenticated in Responsible mode and has opened the new-device linking flow.
steps:
1. Open the device-linking flow.
2. Select the Scan QR / QR method instead of the PIN method.
3. Observe the QR display.
expected_result: The QR method is displayed as a separate alternative. Selecting QR does not simultaneously require PIN entry. Full scanning/linking is out of scope until Protected mode is ready.

title: Switch between PIN and QR alternatives
description: Verify that the user can choose one linking method without combining both methods.
preconditions: User is on the device-linking screen.
steps:
1. Select the PIN tab.
2. Verify the PIN entry/generation view.
3. Select the QR tab.
4. Verify the QR view.
expected_result: Only the selected method is active at a time; the two methods remain independent alternatives.

title: Display the daily-use Home after returning from setup
description: Verify the Home screen state after the user chooses to return to Home.
preconditions: Initial Responsible setup has been completed.
steps:
1. Select Return to Home / Go to Home.
2. Inspect the Home screen content and layout.
expected_result: The normal daily-use Home is displayed, not the first-time setup Home.

title: Open and review linked-device list
description: Verify that the Responsible user can view devices currently linked to the account.
preconditions: Authenticated Responsible account has at least one linked device in the current build/test data.
steps:
1. Open Devices.
2. Review the linked-device list.
expected_result: The list displays the linked devices and their available identifying/status information without missing or duplicated entries.

title: Edit linked-device details
description: Verify that device details can be edited and saved.
preconditions: At least one linked device is present.
steps:
1. Open Devices.
2. Select a linked device.
3. Choose Edit.
4. Modify an editable field with valid data.
5. Save changes.
expected_result: The updated device details are saved and displayed correctly in the Responsible app and are reflected on the other device where the product supports synchronization.

title: Edit personal data associated with a linked device
description: Verify the personal-data editing form and persistence.
preconditions: A linked device is present and the personal-data edit option is available.
steps:
1. Open the linked-device details.
2. Open the personal-data editing option.
3. Modify one or more editable fields with valid data.
4. Save changes.
expected_result: The form accepts valid data and the updated personal information is displayed after saving. Changes synchronize to the other device where applicable.

title: Cancel editing linked-device details
description: Verify that unsaved edits are discarded when the user cancels.
preconditions: A linked device is present and its edit form is open.
steps:
1. Modify one or more fields.
2. Select Back or Cancel without saving.
3. Reopen the device details.
expected_result: The original saved values remain unchanged; unsaved modifications are not persisted.

title: Start device unlinking and display first confirmation
description: Verify the first confirmation step before unlinking a device.
preconditions: A linked device is present.
steps:
1. Open Devices.
2. Select the device to unlink.
3. Choose Delete / Unlink.
expected_result: The first confirmation dialog is displayed and identifies the unlinking action and its consequences.

title: Cancel device unlinking at first confirmation
description: Verify that cancellation at the first confirmation preserves the link.
preconditions: A linked device is present and the first unlink confirmation is displayed.
steps:
1. Select Cancel or the option to go back.
2. Return to the device list.
expected_result: The device remains linked and is still present in the list.

title: Complete both device unlink confirmations
description: Verify that unlinking requires both confirmation steps and removes the device from the list.
preconditions: A linked device is present and the unlink action is available.
steps:
1. Open the device unlink action.
2. Accept the first confirmation.
3. Review the second confirmation.
4. Confirm unlinking in the second dialog.
5. Return to the device list.
expected_result: Both confirmations are required. After the second confirmation, the device is unlinked and no longer appears in the linked-device list. The change is reflected on the other device where applicable.

title: Enforce 24-hour relinking wait for the same device
description: Verify the stated 24-hour restriction after unlinking a device.
preconditions: A device has just been successfully unlinked; its identity is available for another linking attempt.
steps:
1. Attempt to link the same device again before 24 hours have elapsed.
2. Observe the app response.
expected_result: The same device cannot be linked again before the 24-hour waiting period expires, and the app communicates the restriction clearly. Exact boundary behavior at 24 hours should be verified when product rules are confirmed.

title: Activate Self-Control without linking another device
description: Verify Self-Control is independent from protected-device linking.
preconditions: User is authenticated in Responsible mode; no other device is linked.
steps:
1. Open Self-Control.
2. Start the activation flow.
3. Complete the required configuration.
expected_result: Self-Control can be activated without linking another device.

title: Save Self-Control configuration
description: Verify that Self-Control settings persist after saving and navigating away.
preconditions: Self-Control is available and user can access its settings.
steps:
1. Open Self-Control settings.
2. Change an available setting.
3. Save or confirm changes.
4. Navigate away and return to Self-Control settings.
expected_result: The saved settings persist and are displayed consistently after reopening the section.

title: Verify Self-Control site blocking behavior
description: Verify that a configured blocked site is actually restricted on the Responsible device.
preconditions: Self-Control is active; a safe test domain is configured as blocked; test device has internet access.
steps:
1. Configure a test website as blocked in Self-Control.
2. Save the configuration.
3. Open the test website using the supported browser on the same device.
expected_result: The configured site is blocked according to the feature behavior. Record the exact browser, URL and observed message in Actual Result.

title: Verify Self-Control can be disabled or reconfigured
description: Verify the available controls for changing or disabling Self-Control.
preconditions: Self-Control is active and its settings screen is accessible.
steps:
1. Open Self-Control settings.
2. Modify or disable the protection using the available controls.
3. Save or confirm the change.
4. Verify the resulting state.
expected_result: The requested configuration change is applied and the UI reflects the current Self-Control state.
